title: Prepare the boards, parts and tools
准备板子、元件和工具
actions: Fabricate the main PCB; add one bare C5 JSH only if self-assembling it. Use the linked four-layer files in the README.
Order parts by exact value, package and rating. Keep the five matched stock pools separate from unqualified substitutes.
Prepare magnification, ESD handling, paste/stencil and controlled reflow equipment, tweezers, a multimeter, current-limited USB source and SWD probe. Keep the battery disconnected.
按 README 中的四层制板文件制作主板；自行焊子板时再制作一块 C5 JSH 裸板。
逐项核对阻值、容量、封装及额定参数，将已匹配的五种库存与未经确认的替代件分开放置。
准备放大观察、静电防护、锡膏／钢网、可控回流设备、镊子、万用表、限流 USB 电源及 SWD 探针；电池保持断开。
check: Freeze actual MPNs and a compatible soldering profile before applying paste. A soldering iron alone cannot complete hidden underside joints.
先确认实际料号和兼容焊接曲线，再印锡膏；仅用烙铁不能完成底部隐藏焊点。
labels: 主板 1 块；可选自焊 C5 裸板 1 块
主板 76 只；可选 C5 元件 7 只
全部焊接期间保持电池断开

title: Identify and inspect the bare PCB
识别正反面并检查裸 PCB
actions: Identify the front sensing face and rear component face; the numbered illustrations show which face is visible.
Check the 29 mounting holes, board edge and clean sensing electrodes. Do not sand, tin or coat the sensing pads.
Inspect bare-board copper/mask defects and compare the received dimensions/thickness with the fabrication requirements.
区分正面感应电极与背面元件；按图中的视角说明辨认方向。
检查 29 个安装孔、板边及感应电极清洁度，不打磨、不上锡、不涂覆感应焊盘。
检查铜箔和阻焊缺陷，并按工艺说明核对实收尺寸及板厚。
check: There are 74 alternative electrode sites but only 60 installed keys. Never populate sensing pads as switches or add per-key diodes.
PCB 有 74 个备选电极位置，实际安装 60 个按键；电极不是待焊开关，不增加每键二极管。
labels: 背面：全部焊装电子元件
29 个安装孔；实装 60 个按键

title: Support the PCB and print solder paste
支撑主板并印刷锡膏
actions: Hold the PCB flat, component face upward, without scratching or bending the sensing face.

Align a qualified stencil to the current B.Paste pattern, with JP1 apertures blocked/omitted in the approved stencil plan. Print once, lift vertically and inspect deposits for bridges or missing paste.
Inspect U5/U6 exposed-pad apertures and the module lands especially carefully. Ordinary open thermal vias need process control against solder wicking.
用平整治具支撑 PCB，元件面向上，避免划伤或弯曲感应面。
将确认过的钢网对准当前 B.Paste 图形，按钢网方案封住或去掉 JP1 开口；印刷后垂直提起，检查连膏、少膏及偏移。
重点检查 U5／U6 裸露焊盘和主控模组焊盘；普通开放散热孔需要控制吸锡。
check: The native paste drawing is not a qualified stencil recipe. Confirm aperture reduction/segmentation and paste/profile with the assembler; do not flood a thermal pad with solder.
原生锡膏层不等于已经验收的钢网配方；须确认减量／分窗、锡膏及温度曲线，不能向散热盘堆锡。
labels: 平整支撑；垂直提起钢网

title: Place all 43 resistors
放置全部 43 只电阻
actions: Sort 0402 resistors by value and use the reference table below, not body appearance.
Place R30/R31 as 0 ohm links. Fit R40=2.21k, R55=69.8k and R56=1.69k, all 1%; do not use approximate stock values.
Fit the remaining gain, pull-down, LED and divider resistors. Leave JP1 open.
按阻值分装 0402 电阻，逐一按下表位号放置，不能靠外观辨别阻值。
R30／R31 装零欧姆；R40=2.21k、R55=69.8k、R56=1.69k，均为 1%，不能用相近库存阻值替代。
完成其余增益、下拉、指示灯及分压电阻；JP1 保持空置。
check: Count 43 fitted resistors. Resistors have no polarity; value and location are critical.
核对共 43 只电阻；电阻无极性，但阻值和位置必须正确。

title: Place all 17 capacitors
放置全部 17 只电容
actions: Fit C10 as 220 pF C0G 0402, and C47 as 10 nF 0402. Follow the table for all remaining capacitors.
Use stock 100 nF only at C9/C11/C12/C31, and stock 1 uF only at C13/C48.
Keep C40/C44 and the bulk capacitors in their specified 0603 packages. Check voltage, dielectric and effective DC-biased capacitance.
C10 装 0402、220 pF、C0G，C47 装 0402、10 nF；其余按下表放置。
库存 100 nF 仅用于 C9／C11／C12／C31；库存 1 µF 仅用于 C13／C48。
C40／C44 和大容量电容保持指定的 0603 封装，确认耐压、介质及直流偏压下有效容量。
check: Count 17 capacitors. These specified ceramic capacitors are non-polarized; do not substitute larger 0805 stock into 0603 sites.
核对共 17 只电容；指定陶瓷电容无极性，不能将库存 0805 直接装入 0603 焊盘。

title: Place power and protection devices
放置电源及保护元件
actions: Align the actual package pin-1 marks to the native pad-1 positions for U5 BQ24074, U6 TPS63031 and U7/U8 TPS22919.
Fit L1 as the specified 1.5 uH part and F1 as the mainboard 1206/0.5 A fuse; the C5 fuse is different.
Fit D1 PRTR5V0U2X in its exact SOT-143 orientation. Inspect the underside-pad paste before setting down U5/U6.
将 U5 BQ24074、U6 TPS63031、U7／U8 TPS22919 的实际封装一脚标识与原生焊盘 1 对齐。
L1 使用指定的 1.5 µH 电感，F1 使用主板要求的 1206／0.5 A 保险丝；它与 C5 的保险丝不同。
D1 PRTR5V0U2X 按 SOT-143 原生脚序放置；放下 U5／U6 前先检查底部焊盘锡膏。
check: Do not omit U5/U6 exposed ground pads or replace the inductor with a ferrite bead. Package dots must be checked against the actual supplier drawing.
不能漏焊 U5／U6 底部接地散热盘，也不能用磁珠代替电感；封装标识须按实际厂商图纸核对。
labels: Main F1 = 0.5 A; C5 F1 = 1.5 A
一脚位置取自原生 PCB
主板 F1 为 0.5 A；C5 F1 为 1.5 A

title: Place the EC analog front end
放置静电容模拟前端
actions: Fit U2 and U4 as 74HC4051PW TSSOP-16, not HCT or a different package.
Fit U3 OPA350UA SOIC-8; it is neither the dual OPA2350 nor an MSOP device.
Align pin 1, inspect the fine leads and avoid moving the surrounding 0402 parts.
U2／U4 使用 TSSOP-16 的 74HC4051PW，不能用 HCT 或其他封装。
U3 使用 SOIC-8 的 OPA350UA，不能用双路 OPA2350 或 MSOP 封装。
对齐一脚，检查细引脚，避免碰移周围的 0402 元件。
check: All three ICs must match the native pad-1 marks and BOM. JP1 is still open.
三只芯片均须符合原生焊盘一脚位置与材料表；JP1 继续保持空置。

title: Place the single nRF52840 module
放置唯一的 nRF52840 模组
actions: Confirm Raytac MDBT50Q-1MV2, including the actual ordering suffix; do not use the stock nice!nano board.
Match the module drawing, pin 1 and antenna end to the native footprint. Check the underside lands before placement.
Keep paste and metal debris out of the antenna area. Place the module flat without sliding it across neighboring pads.
确认使用 Raytac MDBT50Q-1MV2 及正确订货后缀，不使用库存 nice!nano 开发板。
根据模组图纸核对一脚、天线端和原生焊盘方向，放置前检查底部焊盘。
天线区域不沾锡膏和金属碎屑；模组平放，不在相邻焊盘上拖动。
check: This is a module soldered directly to the PCB, with underside joints. No headers or second controller are installed.
这是直接焊接在 PCB 上的模组，包含底部焊点；不安装排针或第二颗主控。
labels: 按原生焊盘 1 核对方向
底部焊盘需要回流焊接

title: Place connectors, switches and the LED
放置连接器、开关和指示灯
actions: Fit main J1 SH and J2 PH in the native side-entry orientation; align the retention feet as well as signal pins.
Fit SW1 reset and SW100 power controls. Find OFF electrically: with power absent, SW100 pin 2 connects to GND pin 3 in OFF, not VSYS pin 1.
Fit D2 only with a qualified 0603 LED: cathode at pad 1 GND, anode at pad 2 LED_A. Confirm all these parts accept the common reflow process.
按原生侧插方向放置主板 J1 的 SH 座和 J2 的 PH 座，同时对齐固定脚及信号脚。
放置 SW1 复位键和 SW100 电源开关。断电测量 OFF 档：此时 SW100 的 2 脚应接到接地的 3 脚，而不是 VSYS 的 1 脚。
D2 使用经过确认的 0603 LED，阴极对应焊盘 1 GND，阳极对应焊盘 2 LED_A；确认本步元件兼容共同回流工艺。
check: All 76 fitted parts are now placed. JP1 is absent and J3 is bare probe pads. If any chosen part cannot share the profile, revise the stencil/assembly plan before printing, rather than leaving unpopulated paste deposits.
至此已放置全部 76 只实装件，JP1 不装，J3 保持探针焊盘。若某个实际物料不能采用共同曲线，须在印膏前调整钢网／焊接方案，不能将未放件的锡膏留着回流。
labels: J1 SH; J2 PH, side entry
J1 为 SH；J2 为 PH，均侧插
SW100 关闭档：2 脚接 3 脚

title: Reflow, cool and inspect the solder joints
回流、冷却并检查焊点
actions: Run the qualified paste/component profile with a measured board-temperature record. Do not use an invented universal oven or hot-air setting.
Let the supported board cool before moving it. Inspect for shifted parts, tombstones, bridges, opens and solder balls.

Inspect accessible joints under magnification and arrange X-ray/process evidence for U5/U6/module underside joints. Repair defects with controlled rework, then clean and fully dry using a materials-compatible process.
使用经过确认的锡膏／元件曲线，并记录实测板温；不采用虚构的通用炉温或热风档位。
支撑板子充分冷却后再移动，检查偏移、立碑、连锡、虚焊及锡珠。
放大检查可见焊点，对 U5／U6／模组底部焊点取得 X 光或工艺验证证据；受控返修后按材料兼容流程清洁并彻底干燥。
check: An attractive outer fillet does not prove an underside joint is soldered. Keep the battery and case away from all heating operations.
外侧焊点好看不能证明底部已经焊好；任何加热操作均不带电池和外壳进行。
labels: Inspect hidden joints, not only edges
检查隐藏焊点，不只看外侧

title: Complete the unpowered electrical checks
完成断电电气检查
actions: Disconnect USB, battery and debugger. Confirm SW100 OFF and inspect JP1 remains unbridged.
Measure settled resistance from VBUS/USB_5V, VSYS and +3.3V to GND. A brief capacitor-charging beep alone is not a short diagnosis.
Verify connector numbering, D2 polarity, fuse paths and solder bridges under magnification. Record results before applying power.
断开 USB、电池和调试器，确认 SW100 关闭、JP1 未被锡桥短接。
测量 VBUS／USB_5V、VSYS、+3.3V 对地的稳定电阻；不能仅凭电容充电时的短暂蜂鸣判断短路。
核对连接器编号、D2 极性及保险丝通路，并放大排查连锡；记录结果后再上电。
check: Resolve persistent hard shorts or abnormal readings first. No universal resistance threshold is claimed for this populated circuit.
持续硬短路或异常读数须先排除；本电路没有凭空指定的通用电阻合格阈值。
labels: Check VBUS, VSYS and 3.3V to GND
检查电源各网络对地情况

title: Optional C5: print paste and place seven parts
自焊 C5 分支：印锡膏并放置七只元件
actions: Skip this step only if using a populated C5. For self-assembly, use the pinned four-layer C5 JSH board and local seven-part BOM.
Support its F.Cu component face upward and print the qualified F.Paste stencil. Place R1/R2=5.1k, U1 TPD4E05U06DQAR, D1 SMF6.0A and F1 ASMD1206-150.
Place USB-C J1 and SH J2, checking all signal and shell/retention lands. Align U1 pin 1 and the D1 cathode to the actual footprint/net drawing.
购买成品 C5 时跳过本分支；自焊时使用固定版本四层 C5 JSH 裸板及本仓库七只元件表。
将 F.Cu 元件面朝上支撑，按确认过的 F.Paste 钢网印膏；放置 R1／R2=5.1k、U1 TPD4E05U06DQAR、D1 SMF6.0A 及 F1 ASMD1206-150。
放置 USB-C 的 J1 和 SH 的 J2，核对信号脚及外壳／固定脚；按实际焊盘与网络图检查 U1 一脚和 D1 阴极。
check: The two CC resistors are independent. Do not connect CC1 to CC2. Stock USB-C substitutes still require dimensional confirmation.
两个 CC 下拉电阻互相独立，不能将 CC1 与 CC2 短接；库存 USB-C 替代插座仍须确认尺寸。
labels: C5 uses F.Paste, not main B.Paste
C5 用 F.Paste，不是主板 B.Paste
共 7 只元件；R1／R2 用库存
CC1 与 CC2 保持独立

title: Optional C5: reflow and inspect both USB rows
自焊 C5 分支：回流并检查 USB 两排触点
actions: Use a separately qualified C5 paste/component profile and let the board cool before inspection.
Inspect USB-C fine signal contacts and shell anchors; verify both reversible D+/D- contact groups connect to their intended nets without adjacent shorts.
Inspect the underside U1 USON joints and D1 polarity, then test SH numbered continuity, fuse continuity and separate CC pull-down paths.
按 C5 实际物料确认的曲线回流，冷却后再检查。
检查 USB-C 细信号脚与外壳固定脚，核对正反插两组 D+／D− 触点各自接到正确网络且相邻不短路。
检查 U1 的 USON 底部焊点及 D1 极性，再核对 SH 编号通路、保险丝导通及两个独立 CC 下拉。
check: A mechanically fitting USB plug does not prove its contacts are soldered. The seven C5 parts are not part of the mainboard's count of 76.
USB 插头能插入不代表触点已经焊好；C5 的七只元件不包含在主板的 76 只中。
labels: Inspect USB contacts and shell anchors
检查 USB 触点及外壳固定脚
U1 包含底部隐藏焊点
D1 阴极接保险丝后的 VCOM

title: Check C5 and the four-wire USB harness
检查 C5 与四芯 USB 线束
actions: Use two SHR-04V-S housings and eight suitable contacts with AWG28 stranded conductors, OD <=0.8 mm each.
With every power source removed, check numbered continuity: C5 SH pin 1 to main J1 pin 1, then 2-to-2, 3-to-3 and 4-to-4; check adjacent isolation.
Verify crimps and latches before mating. Use the controlled individual lengths; the 150 mm centerline is not a universal equal-wire cut length.
使用两个 SHR-04V-S 插壳、八个匹配端子及 AWG28 多股导线，每根绝缘外径不超过 0.8 mm。
完全断电，逐编号测量 C5 的 SH 1 脚到主板 J1 的 1 脚，以及 2→2、3→3、4→4，并检查相邻线不短路。
插接前检查压接和卡扣；按受控的逐线长度制作，150 mm 中心线不等于四根线都剪 150 mm。
check: Numbered continuity governs. Opposing plugs can look reversed; wire colors and visual left/right order are not sufficient.
以编号导通为准；相对的插头看起来可能反向，不能仅凭颜色或视觉左右顺序判断。
labels: Electrical diagram, not plug viewing order
电气示意，不代表插头观察顺序

title: First USB power-up, without a battery
不接电池，首次 USB 上电
actions: Connect the checked C5/harness on an insulating fixture. Leave J2 empty and initially leave SW100 OFF.

Apply a controlled 5 V USB input with a conservative initial 100 mA current limit; this is a bring-up ceiling, not a measured expected current. Stop if it stays in current limit or parts heat abnormally.
Record USB_5V at C40 and VSYS at C43. Turn SW100 ON and check +3.3V at C45 against U6's actual specification. Power down before changing probe wiring.
在绝缘治具上连接已检查的 C5 与线束，J2 保持空置，SW100 初始关闭。
使用受控 5 V USB 输入，首次将限流保守设为 100 mA；这是上电检查上限，不是声称的正常耗电。若持续限流或异常发热，立即断电。
记录 C40 的 USB_5V 及 C43 的 VSYS；开启 SW100 后，在 C45 检查 +3.3V 是否符合 U6 的实际规格，改变探针接线前先断电。
check: Do not raise the current limit to conceal a fault. VSYS is a PowerPath output and need not equal a hypothetical 3.7 V battery. The blank module is not expected to enumerate as a keyboard.
不能通过调高限流掩盖故障；VSYS 为电源路径输出，不要求等于假想的 3.7 V 电池电压，空白模组也不应被要求已枚举为键盘。
labels: J2 空置；受控 5 V 输入
C40 为 USB_5V；C43 为 VSYS

title: Program and verify the calibrator through J3
通过 J3 写入并验证校准固件
actions: Power off before mating the custom six-pogo fixture. Use J3 pin 1 as 3.3 V target reference, not a second supply.
Connect 2 SWDIO, 3 GND, 4 SWDCLK, 5 RESET_N and 6 GND using the actual pad numbers. Power the board through the checked USB path.
Select nRF52840 in the probe tool, program firmware/releases/calibrator/yeti60-raytac.hex, verify its contents and reset. Reserve calibration until the EC mechanical stack is installed.
对接自定义六针治具前先断电，J3 的 1 脚是 3.3 V 目标参考，不用作第二路供电。
按实际编号连接 2 SWDIO、3 地、4 SWDCLK、5 RESET_N、6 地，再通过已检查的 USB 通路为板子供电。
在调试工具中选择 nRF52840，写入 firmware/releases/calibrator/yeti60-raytac.hex，执行校验并复位；装好静电容机械结构后再校准。
check: J3 is not the standard ARM connector pinout. Never attach two active 3.3 V supplies. Later normal-firmware updates must preserve settings at 0xF0000–0xFFFFF.
J3 不是标准 ARM 接口脚序，不能并接两路主动 3.3 V 电源；后续更新普通固件须保留 0xF0000–0xFFFFF 设置区。
labels: J3 使用图中的实际焊盘位置
写入后校验；后续保留设置区

title: Finish the resin shells and bond eight inserts
处理树脂壳并冷粘八个嵌件
actions: Use the current unscaled top/bottom files, fully post-cure the selected resin and inspect shell registration.
Finish four M3 insert seats in the top and four M2 daughterboard seats in the bottom to the specified dimensions.
Cold-bond with resin-compatible structural epoxy; keep adhesive out of threads, align the insert axes and allow full cure before loading.
使用当前原尺寸上下壳文件，按所选树脂充分后固化，检查壳体对位。
按指定尺寸精修上壳四个 M3 嵌件孔和底壳四个子板 M2 嵌件孔。
用兼容树脂的结构环氧胶冷粘，螺纹内不进胶，保持轴线正确，完全固化后再受力。
check: Do not heat-insert into thermoset resin or substitute unqualified RTV. Confirm actual bore sizes, insert flushness and thread depth on samples.
不能在热固性树脂上采用热熔嵌件，也不直接用未经确认的 RTV 替代结构胶；先检查实孔、嵌件端面及螺纹深度。
labels: 上壳：4 个 M3 嵌件
底壳：4 个 M2 嵌件

title: Prepare the steel plate and 60 housings
准备钢定位板并装配 60 套轴壳
actions: Deburr the 1.2 mm stainless plate, finish its 29 M2 threads and clean all metal debris away from the PCB.
Dry-fit matched independently mountable Topre-compatible housings/sliders at all 60 active positions.
Fit the matched stabilized housings, wires and clips for wide keys and the 6U HHKB spacebar. Test free movement before adding domes.
为 1.2 mm 不锈钢定位板去毛刺，完成 29 个 M2 螺纹，清除金属碎屑后再靠近 PCB。
在 60 个实际按键位置试装成套、可独立安装的兼容 Topre 轴壳及滑块。
宽键和 HHKB 6U 空格采用匹配的稳定轴壳、钢丝及卡扣；装胶碗前先检查滑动是否顺畅。
check: Qualify a normal key, wide key and 6U spacebar first. Original HHKB integrated-plate housings and generic 7U MX stabilizers are not assumed compatible.
先验证普通键、宽键和 6U 空格样件；不假设原版 HHKB 一体板轴壳或通用 7U MX 卫星轴兼容。
labels: 先验证普通／宽键／6U 样件

title: Center the domes and conical sensing springs
对齐胶碗与锥形感应弹簧
actions: Use a jig to hold the plate/housings inverted without loading the slider stems.
Place matched domes with their crowns toward the sliders. Each conical spring has its narrow end toward the dome crown and wide base toward the PCB.
Use the active-key map to center 60 spring bases over their electrodes. Keep the 14 unused layout positions empty.
用治具倒置支撑定位板／轴壳，避免滑块轴心承压。
放置匹配胶碗，凸起顶部朝向滑块；每个锥形弹簧窄端朝胶碗顶部，宽底朝 PCB。
按实际按键位置图将 60 个弹簧宽底与电极居中，14 个未使用布局位置保持空置。
check: Spring/dome shapes in the section are illustrative. Check the chosen parts' actual seating and return; do not solder conical springs to electrodes.
剖面中的胶碗／弹簧外形为示意，须检查所选实物的落位与回弹；锥形弹簧不焊接到电极上。
labels: Wide spring base toward sensing PCB
滑块→胶碗顶部→弹簧窄端
弹簧宽底朝向感应 PCB

title: Install the 29 insulated PCB fastener sets
安装 29 套绝缘 PCB 紧固件
actions: Install the adapter standoffs under the tapped plate: 4.50 mm brass shoulder, upper M2 stud and lower M1.6 female thread.
Place a 0.10 mm polyimide ring between every shoulder and the PCB sensing face, then lower the PCB without shifting the springs.
From the component side, fit 0.8 mm PEEK washers, OD <=4 mm, and 29 M1.6 x 5 screws. Tighten progressively with sample-qualified torque.
在已攻牙定位板下安装转接柱：黄铜肩高 4.50 mm，上部 M2 外牙，下部 M1.6 内牙。
每个铜柱肩与 PCB 感应面之间放置 0.10 mm 聚酰亚胺环，落下 PCB 时不移位弹簧。
从元件面安装 0.8 mm 厚、外径不超过 4 mm 的 PEEK 垫圈及 29 只 M1.6×5 螺丝，按样件确认的扭矩逐步均匀紧固。
check: Nominal plate-to-PCB gap is 4.60 mm. Do not use the stock M1.6 x 2 screws, metal washers against sensing copper, or force misaligned holes.
标称板间距为 4.60 mm；不能用库存 M1.6×2 短螺丝，不能让金属垫圈压感应铜面，也不能强迫错位孔对齐。

title: Fit lower gaskets, C5 and open guide bases
安装下侧垫片、C5 和开口走线底座
actions: Cut the specified 2 mm gasket stock to the existing lower ledges, keeping ports, wires and service openings clear.
Fit C5 on its four M2 inserts with M2 x 4 screws and 0.30 mm insulating washers; inspect USB-mouth alignment.
Bond the two rear guide bases and one front base at the checked case coordinates. Leave the two rear bridges removable and support the plate/PCB assembly above the case while routing.
将指定的 2 mm 缓冲垫材料裁到原有下侧支承台阶，不覆盖端口、走线和检修开口。
用四只 M2×4 螺丝及 0.30 mm 绝缘垫圈固定 C5，检查 USB 开口对位。
按检查过的壳体坐标粘接两个后侧底座和一个前侧底座；两个后侧桥盖保持可拆，走线时用治具支撑尚未落下的定位板／PCB 总成。
check: Do not scale the placed guide files or stack them at a common origin. Let base adhesive cure before installing wires.
不可缩放已定位的走线支架文件，也不能将它们按共同原点叠放；底座胶固化后再装线。
labels: 下侧垫片贴在原有台阶
后侧底座 2 个＋前侧底座 1 个

title: Inspect and retain the qualified battery pack
检查并固定经过确认的电池包
actions: Accept only the specified protected single-cell 1600 mAh pack with supplier-approved full envelope <=85 x 43 x 4.8 mm, independent thermal interruption and separate NTC.
Before mating J2, measure pack polarity and verify the custom PHR-3 numbering: 1 positive, 2 negative, 3 10k NTC to negative.
Place nonconductive removable retention and edge protection in the pocket, keeping the total floor budget <=0.20 mm. Leave the pack electrically disconnected until all routing checks pass.
只接受指定受保护 1600 mAh 单电芯包，供方确认完整包络≤85×43×4.8 mm，具备独立温度切断和单独 NTC。
插 J2 前先测量极性，并核对自定义 PHR-3 编号：1 正极、2 负极、3 为接负极的 10k NTC。
在电池槽内布置绝缘、可拆固定及边缘保护，槽底总厚度预算不超过 0.20 mm；全部走线检查合格前，电池电气连接保持断开。
check: No soldering or hot work near the pack. Do not use the stock 110 mAh cell, compress the pouch or infer polarity from plug shape.
电池附近不焊接、不加热；不使用库存 110 mAh 电芯，不挤压软包，不通过插头外形推断极性。
labels: J2：1 正／2 负／3 温度线

title: Lay the seven wires and close the removable guides
铺设七根导线并封好可拆走线桥
actions: Lay three lower battery wires in the rear bases, fit the two removable bridges using 0.05 mm side-land tape, then lay four upper USB wires.
Route the front USB loop through its base; preserve the checked bends and keep all wires away from screws, edges and the pouch.

Apply three upper insulating retention pieces, film plus adhesive <=0.10 mm, wrapped down the guide sides. Recheck continuity/polarity, mate J1 and finally J2, then lower the supported assembly without pinching wires.
后侧底座先铺三根下层电池线，侧边用总厚度 0.05 mm 胶带固定两个可拆桥盖，再铺四根上层 USB 线。
前侧 USB 回环放入对应底座，保持受控弯曲，导线不碰螺钉、锐边和电池软包。
贴三片上层绝缘固定膜，膜加胶总厚度≤0.10 mm，并沿桥盖侧面包下；复核导通／极性后插 J1，最后插 J2，再将治具支撑的总成落下，避免夹线。
check: USB inner bend radii are at least 4.5 mm; battery at least 5 mm in the checked route. Do not permanently epoxy removable bridges or leave a floating retention strip.
受检路径中 USB 最小内侧弯曲半径至少 4.5 mm，电池线至少 5 mm；不将可拆桥盖永久粘死，不留下悬空固定膜。
labels: 上层：4 根 USB 线
2 个可拆桥盖＋3 片固定膜

title: Fit 60 matched keycaps and check travel
安装 60 个匹配键帽并检查行程
actions: Support the plate while pressing compatible caps onto the selected slider stems. Fit the matched 6U spacebar and stabilized wide caps without bending wires.
Check every cap's clearance, full travel and return, including the perimeter and adjacent wide keys.
Check the Fn key and all active positions against the HHKB mapping. Do not assume the stock 133-key set is compatible without a stem/spacebar check.
支撑定位板，再将兼容键帽压到所选滑块轴心上；安装匹配的 6U 空格及宽键键帽，不弯曲稳定钢丝。
逐键检查边缘及相邻宽键的间隙、完整行程与回弹。
按 HHKB 映射核对 Fn 及所有实际按键；未确认轴心和空格兼容性前，不直接使用库存 133 键套装。
check: All 60 keys move freely before calibration. Correct binding mechanically instead of masking it with scan thresholds.
校准前 60 个键都应自由运动；机械卡滞先修复，不能靠调整扫描阈值掩盖。

title: Calibrate every key, save and load normal firmware
逐键校准、保存并写入普通固件
actions: Boot the calibrator with the complete mechanical stack at its intended preload. Run yeti_calibrate release with every key released; wait for the 128-frame completion message.

Use firmware/target/calibration-keys.csv. Hold each selected key BEFORE yeti_calibrate press ROW COL; keep holding until the 128-sample completion message. Repeat for all 60 keys, inspect yeti_calibrate status, then run yeti_calibrate save. Bare press is rejected.

Power down before reconnecting SWD. Program and verify firmware/releases/normal/yeti60-raytac.hex using range/sector-aware flashing that preserves 0xF0000–0xFFFFF. Restart and check that calibration is retained.
完整机械结构按预定预压状态支撑，启动校准固件；全部松键执行 yeti_calibrate release，等待 128 帧采样完成提示。
按 firmware/target/calibration-keys.csv 操作，先按住目标键，再执行 yeti_calibrate press ROW COL；保持按住至 128 个采样完成后松开。逐个覆盖 60 键，检查 yeti_calibrate status，再执行 yeti_calibrate save；旧的无行列 press 命令会被拒绝。
重新连接 SWD 前先断电；按写入范围／扇区操作方式写入并校验 firmware/releases/normal/yeti60-raytac.hex，保留 0xF0000–0xFFFFF，重启检查校准仍然有效。
check: Do not use full-chip erase/recover after saving calibration. Rejected ranges or ADC saturation require diagnosis. Keys intentionally emit no events before valid calibration.
保存校准后不使用全片擦除或恢复操作；量程不足、ADC 饱和须排查，没有有效校准时固件刻意不输出按键。
labels: 松键→指定行列按键→保存
按住直到 128 个采样完成
保留末尾 64 KiB 设置区

title: Test USB, BLE and charge-state behavior open
开壳检查 USB、蓝牙及充电状态
actions: Using normal firmware, test every key over USB, held keys, multiple keys and reset/reconnect behavior.
With the accepted battery, disconnect USB and test BLE. Fn+Q/W/E/R/T select profiles 0/1/2/3/4 in the current keymap; verify pairing and retained bonds on the intended hosts.

Check configured-host USB500 behavior separately from preconfiguration, suspend and switch-off USB100 behavior. Record actual current/temperature; the predicted runtime is not an acceptance measurement.
使用普通固件，通过 USB 检查逐键、长按、多键及复位重连。
使用验收过的电池，拔掉 USB 后检查蓝牙；当前键位 Fn+Q／W／E／R／T 分别选择 0／1／2／3／4 号配置，检查目标主机配对及绑定保留。
分别检查主机完成配置后的 USB500，以及配置前、挂起和关机 USB100 状态；记录实测电流／温度，不把估算续航当作验收数据。
check: A successful firmware build is not this test. Complete the pack's thermal/charge qualification before relying on charging; no battery-percentage reporting is enabled.
构建成功不等于本步实测通过；依赖充电功能前先完成电池温度／充电验收，当前未开启电量百分比上报。
labels: BLE: Fn + Q / W / E / R / T

title: Fit upper gaskets and close the shell
安装上侧垫片并合壳
actions: Remove USB and switch off before final handling; disconnect the pack if adjusting the internal wiring. Fit upper gaskets only on the original ledges.
Check no wire or retention film protrudes into mating surfaces. Close the shell without force, preserving plate registration and the qualified gasket compression.
Fit four M3 x 5 screws with 0.30 mm shims and tighten progressively. If key feel or sensing changes after closure, reopen and correct the stack before recalibrating.
最终操作前拔掉 USB 并关闭电源；调整内部走线时再断开电池。上侧垫片只贴在原有台阶。
检查导线和固定膜均不伸入合壳面，不用蛮力压合，保持定位板对位及确认过的垫片压缩量。
安装四只 M3×5 螺丝及 0.30 mm 垫片，逐步均匀紧固；若合壳后手感或感应改变，先开壳修正结构，再重新校准。
check: Check no insert bottoms out, no pouch pressure and no clipped wires. The unqualified longer stock screws are not default substitutes.
检查螺丝不顶底、电池不受压、导线不被夹；未经确认的库存长螺丝不是默认替代件。
labels: 上侧垫片贴在原有台阶

title: Fit four feet and repeat the final checks
安装四个脚垫并完成最终检查
actions: Clean the four original underside pockets and install four adhesive-backed SKUF feet, 41.8 x 5.8 x 2 mm. Do not cover the SW100 service port.
Set the keyboard on a flat surface; check stable support, USB access and SW100 operation through the 8 mm port using an insulated tool.
Repeat all 60 keys, wide-key return, USB/BLE reconnect and an unplugged power cycle. Save the measured bring-up/calibration/assembly records for this serial-numbered unit.
清洁底部四个原有脚垫槽，贴四只带背胶 SKUF 脚垫，规格 41.8×5.8×2 mm，不遮挡 SW100 检修孔。
在平面上检查支撑稳定、USB 插拔空间，并用绝缘工具通过 8 mm 检修孔操作 SW100。
再次检查全部 60 键、宽键回弹、USB／蓝牙重连及拔线后的重新上电，并为这台样机保存上电、校准和装配实测记录。
check: Complete first-article acceptance remains required. No completed hardware, lifetime, charging or RF certification is implied by these illustrations.
仍须完成首件实测验收；这些示意图不代表已经取得实物、寿命、充电或射频认证。
labels: 4 x SKUF feet, 41.8 x 5.8 x 2 mm
Keep the 8 mm service port clear
保持 8 mm 检修孔畅通
